about: The cost model of a2vm (tools/a2vm/cost.h): what each bus access costs on the Appletini in TURBO mode, in fabric clocks unless the name says otherwise.

Every value is derived from the firmware source, appletini-one origin/main (F1.2.1, commit be2ea4f), or from the firmware documents in docs/firmware/ of this port; 'source' gives the file and line. Paths without a directory are under hdl/apple/ of appletini-one; 'core_top' is hdl/apple/vtw_core_top.sv.
None of these values has been measured on the card (milestone 0 will): they are derived from the RTL and the documents, as docs/MILESTONES.md 3.1 asks.

The one parameter that may be calibrated is turbo_extra, the effective TURBO rate for code in fast memory. It is NOT calibrated here: its value is the RTL's, 0 extra clocks, checked against the TURBO benchmark of README_TURBO.md (tests/test_a2vm_cost.py reproduces its 436 clocks).

fabric_mhz.source: apple_bus_wrapper.sv:170 ('~2.1 us at 133.333 MHz'); scripts/create_project.tcl:155 (FCLK0 133 MHz)

line_us.source: apple_video_standard_detect.sv:7 (PAL: 912 dots / 14.25 MHz = 64.000 us). The hardware measurement of the existing port is PAL (demos/doom/docs/STATUS.md, v12). 65 Apple cycles a line: 131.28 fabric clocks a cycle, as ps_sources/frontend/config_menu_help.c:142 says ('131 fabric clocks per cycle')

vbl_line.source: config_menu_help.c:142 ('Both begin vertical blank at scanner line 192')

turbo_hit.source: README_TURBO.md:59-61 ('A cache hit takes two fabric clocks'); core_top:1949-1953 (X_CAPTURE to X_TURBO_DONE), :1243-1244 (turbo_complete), :1968-1969. Checked: the benchmark of hdl/sim/tb_vtw_turbo.sv:717-747 makes 218 accesses a warm pass and takes 436 clocks (README_TURBO.md:32-35)

turbo_write_miss.source: core_top:1971 (miss to X_ROUTE), :2040-2041, :2114-2123: X_CAPTURE, X_TURBO_DONE, X_ROUTE, X_MEM_CAPTURE, X_MEM_DONE; the page entry is filled at X_ROUTE (:1212-1213)

posted_write.source: lazy-mirror-spec.md section 6, confirmed by lazy-mirror-review.md section 2: X_CAPTURE, X_TURBO_DONE, X_ROUTE, X_POST_STALL, X_MEM_CAPTURE, X_MEM_DONE (core_top:2037-2038, :2105-2123); a video write never takes a fast page entry (:1218-1219)

turbo_extra.source: The free parameter of MILESTONES.md 3.1: extra clocks an access to fast memory, for anything the path above misses. Left at 0: the RTL path reproduces the 436 clocks of README_TURBO.md:32-35 exactly

rw_hit.source: cache-plan.md section 2 ('Hit 5 clocks' in TURBO), confirmed by cache-review.md (1); core_top:1952-1953, :1970-1971, :2027-2028, :2045-2052: X_CAPTURE, X_TURBO_DONE, X_ROUTE, X_RW_LOOKUP, X_RW_DONE

rw_request.source: core_top:2054-2068: the request is set at the X_RW_LOOKUP edge, after X_CAPTURE, X_TURBO_DONE and X_ROUTE

psram_read.source: cache-plan.md section 2: 'From the X_RW_LOOKUP edge that sets rw_req_valid_q to core completion is 31 clocks for a read, if admission is immediate' (psram_driver.sv:228-233, rvalid at E26). A clean miss with the window open is 35 clocks (cache-plan.md section 2, 'about 35')

psram_write.source: cache-plan.md section 2 (psram_driver.sv:222-225: write rvalid at E18, ready again after E23, back-to-back period 24): the dirty victim's write, before the fill is requested (core_top:2072-2079)

admit_offset.source: psram_simple.sv:313-321: the window is armed at addr_en + 3; addr_en is tap 3 of the address phase (apple_bus_wrapper.sv:100)

admit_window.source: psram_simple.sv:239 (ADMIT_WINDOW_TAPS = 40); one background admission a bus cycle (psram_simple.sv:228-240, :437-486). A miss that misses the window waits for the next cycle: 'sustained random: one per Apple cycle, about 131 clocks' (cache-plan.md section 2)

drain_rmw.source: cache-plan.md section 3 ('RMW is 55 clocks'): a captured aux mirror write (psram_simple.sv:136, :382-390) has priority over the vTW (psram_simple.sv:439-467, cache-review.md F9)

io_route.source: core_top:1974-2026 (X_ROUTE): a $Cxxx access never takes the TURBO path (:1952-1953)

video_wait.source: core_top:1949-1950, :1957-1962 (X_VIDEO_WAIT while the mirror is pending); README_TURBO.md:128-131 ('one fabric wait state')

bus_drive_tap.source: apple_bus_wrapper.sv:136 (TAP_DRIVE_ADDR = 8): the bus engine launches at drive_en (vtw_bus_engine.sv:840-880)

bus_data_tap.source: apple_bus_wrapper.sv:120 (TAP_DATA_SNAP = 59 after PHI0 rises, half a cycle in): the response (vtw_bus_engine.sv:738-790). 'drive_en to data_en is about 116 clocks' (switches-review.md section 2)

bus_done.source: vtw_bus_engine.sv resp_valid_q (registered at data_en), core_top:2125-2160 (X_BUS, X_BUS_DONE). A $C073 write at a random phase: 120-251 clocks (switches-plan.md section 2)

status_read.source: core_top:577-580 (xl_c01x_rd), :2001-2008, :2189-2195: $C011-$C01F reads complete privately in X_STATUS_DONE

sp_private.source: core_top:674-702 (sp_hit: slot-7 ROM and C8 window, not $CFFF), :2162-2187 (X_SP_ISSUE, X_SP_WAIT, X_SP_DONE); hdl/apple/smartport_card.sv:509-521 (busy one clock, then resp_valid)

rom_read.source: globals.sv:290-312 (internal $C100-$CFFF ROM is the ROM route), core_top:2040-2041, :2114-2123 (X_MEM_CAPTURE, X_MEM_DONE)

quiet_switch.source: switches-plan.md section 3.2 (a quiet switch completes in X_DEAD: CAPTURE, ROUTE, DEAD, 3 clocks); switches-review.md F8 (4 with the mirror pending)

coalescer.source: vtw_video_coalescer.sv, added in appletini-one 2a73c9f (2026-09-12) and in every tag from F1.1.0; lines of be2ea4f (F1.2.1). apple_top.sv:2189 ties video_record_enable high, so every TURBO video write takes it (vtw_core_top.sv:1352-1353; the old write-ordered queue only when !video_selected, :1374-1375). An active write sets its byte and page dirty (:85-90, :106-110); the scanner selects dirty pages in address order, one page index a clock (:119-128), clears the page bit on selection (:100-105) and then takes all 256 bytes of the page (:129-149); the mirror counts as pending until every active page is clean with the scanner between pages (:56-57) and the posted queue idle (vtw_core_top.sv:1466-1471), and a $Cxxx access waits for it (:1414-1415, :1907). Checked on the RTL with Verilator (docs/results/fuzz-timing-2026-09-30.md section 3): a 168-row column drains in 41,854 clocks after its writes, and this model too (that report's prototype patch gave 42,116), the model without the scan 9,690; every other point of that micro-benchmark within 0.1% (rerun on this model's build, 2026-09-30); the replay's draw phase on 13 captured frames within 1%. 0 gives the write-ordered model of before 2026-09-30

scan_byte.source: vtw_video_coalescer.sv:129-139: FETCH_BYTE then CHECK_BYTE for every byte of a selected page, dirty or not; a dirty byte adds SEND_BYTE (:140-149), one clock when the queue has room

post_depth.source: vtw_bus_engine.sv:176-177 (POST_DEPTH_LOG2 = 9: 512 entries), :180 and :369-370 (post_full at 512 - POST_FULL_MARGIN 4); the coalescer's SEND_BYTE waits for !eng_post_full (vtw_core_top.sv:1446)

flush_steer_cycles.source: vtw_video_bank_sync.sv:31-36 and :55-80: a flush sets RAMWRT for each bank it drains (SET_RAMWRT) and restores it at the end; one sync cycle a bank

axi_us.source: Fitted, not measured. With every other parameter fixed, the f121 frame of the existing port (E1M1 standing still, tools/a2vm/cost_report.py) matches the 248.0 ms a frame measured on hardware by host time (demos/doom/build/profiles/e1m1-idle-turbo-v12-amem-batch-pal.json) at 0.135 us; a sweep of 0.10 to 0.305 us on 2026-09-30 gave 238.6 ms at 0.10, 243.6 at 0.12, 249.6 at 0.14, 289.8 at 0.305. The copy phases alone match the hardware's (40.5 ms VBL-sampled plus the 6.9 ms a frame that sampling loses during the ARM's holds) at 0.138 us. The only figure in the firmware documents, appletini-one docs/CODE_REVIEW_2026-08-20_MAIN_LAST3.md:255, '~16K added register reads add ~5-16ms' (0.305 to 0.98 us a read), is an estimate the capture does not fit. Milestone 0 measures it

axi_write_us.source: No figure in the firmware documents; taken equal to a read (an assumption). The fit of axi_us cannot tell reads and writes apart

ps_dispatch_us.source: The PS's latency to take a SmartPort request is not in the source. Bound: removing four requests a frame changed nothing measurable (demos/doom/docs/STATUS.md, 'v12 hardware result: no measured batching gain'), so it is well under 1 ms. The AXI reads that pop the request are counted (amem_request_axi)

amem_request_axi.source: An estimate: the status and control reads of the dispatch (smartport_card.sv exec_pending, MEM_SP_STATUS), plus one read per 4 bytes of the request, added by the model

amem_begin_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:109-127 (hw_begin): hw_available 2 reads (:45-52), RAMWORKS_ENABLE 1, hw_session 3 (:70-82), RW_FLUSH 1; then the REQ write

amem_poll_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:129-143: each poll of the hold reads RW_FLUSH and hw_session (3)

amem_end_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:317-343 (hw_end: hw_held 4, ADDR 1, READ4_STATUS 1) and :94-107 (hw_release: 1 poll read); writes: ADDR and RELEASE

amem_dma_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:149-174 (hw_held 4 before, 4 after) and ps_sources/lib/psdma.c:98-128 (keep_running 4, STATUS 1); plus 3 register writes (psdma.c:121-126). The transfer itself: one PSRAM line an Apple cycle (psram_simple.sv:228-240)

amem_dma_poll_axi.source: psdma.c:130-141: each poll is keep_running (4 reads) and STATUS (1); the last poll after completion is counted

amem_read_word_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:176-218 (hw_shadow_read), per 4 bytes: ready poll (hw_held 4 + READ4_STATUS 1), READ4 write, busy poll (hw_held 4 + status 1), DATA read: 11 reads and 1 write

amem_read_setup_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:183-186: hw_held (4), READ4_STATUS (1), and the ADDR write

amem_write_word_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:254-272 (hw_shadow_write), per 4 bytes: hw_held 4 + DATA4_STATUS 1, then the DATA4 write

amem_write_setup_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:241-244 (hw_held 4, DATA4_STATUS 1, ADDR write) and :220-232 (the final hw_shadow_wait: DATA4_STATUS 1, hw_held 4, ADDR 1)

amem_write_byte_axi.source: memory_api_hw.c:246-252, :275-281: an unaligned byte is hw_held (4), a DATA write and hw_shadow_wait (6)

slowdown_cycles.source: ps_sources/frontend/config_menu.c:76 (CONFIG_DEFAULT_VTW_SLOWDOWN_CYCLES 512U, '1 MHz window per access'), sent as is to the RTL (:4677-4687; apple_top.sv:2172, slow_duration). In the RTL it is the value slow_cnt_q is loaded with on a hit, and slow_cnt_q drops by one each completed CPU cycle (core_top:1884-1898), so it counts CPU cycles; each of them is one Apple cycle at 1 MHz. The profile key vtw.slowdown.cycles sets any value 1-65535 (config_menu.c:3550-3552); 0 with the Phasor enabled becomes 512 (:4681-4683)

slowdown_slot4.source: Whether the virtual Phasor is enabled, which forces slot 4 into the slowdown mask whatever the per-slot setting (config_menu.c:4660-4692). Off by default (config_menu.c:93, CONFIG_DEFAULT_MOCKINGBOARD_SLOT4_ENABLED 0U), and off in f121 and fastpath, whose runs of the existing port touch no slot-4 address in a frame; the 'phasor' variant turns it on. A hit is any completed access to $C400-$C4FF (sd_iosel) or $C0C0-$C0CF (sd_slot_io), read or write (core_top:1119-1144)

slowdown_via_exempt.source: F1.2.1 exempts nothing: sd_hit does not look at the direction or the register (core_top:1141-1144). The 'fws1' variant models the firmware request FW-S1 of docs/research/native-sound.md 4.4 (not in any firmware)

slow_done.source: A memory cycle at 1 MHz ends on the clock after an Apple data strobe that came after the previous cycle ended: pace_tick_pending_q is set at data_en and cleared when a cycle completes (core_top:1849-1856), pace_ok follows it at 1 MHz (:1159-1162), and complete_mem is X_MEM_DONE and pace_ok (:1514). Bus cycles keep their own timing (bus_done)

variants.about: Settings applied on top of a profile (tools/a2vm/costs.py: PROFILE+VARIANT). Each is a setting of the firmware or of the machine, not a change of the RTL, except fws1, a proposal.

phasor.description: The virtual Phasor enabled (the music player's runs).

slowdown_slot4.source: config_menu.c:4679-4680: slot 4 forced into the mask when mockingboard_slot4_enabled

window32.description: The profile setting vtw.slowdown.cycles=32 (native-sound.md 2.3), no firmware change.

slowdown_cycles.source: config_menu.c:3550-3552 (the key accepts any value up to 65535) and :4677-4687 (applied as is)

fws1.description: Firmware request FW-S1 of native-sound.md 4.4: writes to the VIA registers ORB, ORA, DDRB, DDRA, IFR, IER and ORA without handshake do not open the window; reads, and writes to the timers, SR, ACR, PCR, the SSI-263 and the mode switch still do.

slowdown_via_exempt.source: FW-S1 as docs/firmware/fws1-review.md corrects it: writes to ORB and ORA without handshake (registers 0 and F) only; exempt IFR, IER or ORA writes caused a second interrupt in the review's simulation. The VIA registers are the low 4 address bits (mockingboard.sv:73-80 decode); addresses with bit 5 or 6 set also write the SSI-263 (mockingboard.sv:100-103) and stay hits

line_us.source: apple_video_standard_detect.sv:5-8 (NTSC: 912 dots / 14.31818 MHz = 63.695 us a line of 65 PHI0 pulses)

caches_survive.source: core_top:1206-1211: any change of the translation state invalidates both TURBO caches

relaxed_admission.source: psram_simple.sv:437: one admission a bus cycle, inside the 40-clock window

quiet_switches.source: globals.sv:300-304: every $C0xx access is a bus cycle

zp_pair.source: no zero-page bank pair in F1.2.1 (zpbank-spec.md section 0: it is a proposal); a $C069 write is an ordinary bus cycle with no effect (onee_motherboard_io.sv:250-277, zpbank-spec.md 2.2)

lazy_shr.source: vtw_video_policy.sv:25-31: aux graphics are always active mirror pages

f121zp.description: F1.2.1 with the zero-page bank pair alone, armed (docs/firmware/zpbank-spec.md as corrected by zpbank-review.md; the design document's change 5, main zero page only, NATIVE.md 4.5 and 15.1). Every other parameter is f121's: no other change of the design is assumed.

caches_survive.source: as f121 (core_top:1206-1211); the pair is not part of the translation state the invalidation compares, so it never invalidates (zpbank-spec.md 3.2: :1185 becomes translate_state_from_sss(vsss), whose pair fields are constant 0)

rw_lines.source: as f121 (core_top:1032-1060): a redirected access is served through the one line (zpbank-spec.md 3.1: bank 2 or more is xl_is_ramworks, core_top:643-644), 5 clocks on a hit by X_CAPTURE, X_TURBO_DONE, X_ROUTE, X_RW_LOOKUP, X_RW_DONE (zpbank-spec.md section 6)

read_bank.source: the pair replaces the read-bank register at $C069 (zpbank-spec.md, first line); its $C069 write keeps the X_BUS default, no private serve and no barrier exemption (zpbank-spec.md 2.2)

zp_pair.source: zpbank-review.md section 2 (corrected specification): armed when ZPB_ENABLE, vtw_ctrl_q[9] and ramworks_en hold; the kill switch defaults off and a PS profile key turns it on (review finding 3). The profile stands for a firmware with the pair and the key set

lazy_shr.source: as f121 (vtw_video_policy.sv:25-31); redirected writes are never posted or mirrored (zpbank-spec.md section 6, core_top:565-566)

fastpath.description: F1.2.1 with the seven changes of the firmware design, as docs/firmware/ describes them (the design document itself, 'vTW Memory Fast Path: Design', was not read for this model; the list below is taken from the corrected summaries of the reviews in docs/firmware/).
changes: 1. Relaxed PSRAM admission while the vTW owns the bus (cache-review.md, corrected summary, stage 1): relaxed_admission = 1.
2. A small fully associative RamWorks line cache, 16 lines of 8 bytes, write-back (cache-review.md, corrected summary, stage 2): rw_lines = 16.
3. TURBO caches that survive mapping changes, checked against the physical page (switches-plan.md 3.1, switches-review.md section 4 stage 1): caches_survive = 1.

4. Quiet switches for RAMRD, ALTZP, $C08x and $C071/$C073, with a reconciler that replays them before a non-quiet access, flushing aux mirror bytes before a bank replay (switches-review.md section 4, rules O1, O2, O4 of switches-plan.md 3.4): quiet_switches = 1.

5. A lazy mirror class for SHR writes while SHR is selected, flushed by a $C029 write that leaves SHR, a physical $C071/$C073 write, or a hold without KEEP_LAZY (lazy-mirror-review.md section 3): lazy_shr = 1, keep_lazy = 1.
6. The private read bank $C069 with its barrier exemption (read-bank-review.md section 2): read_bank = 1. The existing port never writes $C069, so it changes nothing there.
7. $C071/$C073 in vtw_is_bank_steer (rwbank-review.md 'Independent fix, ship first'): an ordering fix in classic modes, no cost in TURBO.

rw_lines.source: cache-review.md, corrected summary, stage 2 (8-16 lines, fully associative)

relaxed_admission.source: cache-review.md, corrected summary, stage 1; cache-plan.md section 3 (a sustained miss about 36 clocks)

zp_pair.source: fastpath models the read bank of change 6, not the pair (NATIVE.md: the design with the pair is fastzp)

keep_lazy.source: lazy-mirror-review.md F4 (KEEP_LAZY when no destination is in the lazy range)

fastzp.description: The firmware design with the zero-page bank pair in place of the $C069 read bank: fastpath's changes 1-5 and 7, and the pair of docs/firmware/zpbank-spec.md as corrected by zpbank-review.md (the design document's change 5, main zero page only: NATIVE.md 4.5 and 15.1), armed. This is the 'Design + pair' column of NATIVE.md.

rw_lines.source: cache-review.md, corrected summary, stage 2 (as fastpath); redirected accesses use the same lines (zpbank-spec.md section 6, 'RamWorks line cache')

relaxed_admission.source: cache-review.md, corrected summary, stage 1 (as fastpath); redirected accesses are ordinary line-port traffic of banks 2 or more (zpbank-spec.md section 6)

quiet_switches.source: switches-review.md section 4, stages 2-3 (as fastpath); $C069 is not in the quiet set, so its write is reconciled and goes to the bus

read_bank.source: the pair replaces the read bank at $C069 (zpbank-spec.md, first line): the write is an ordinary bus cycle (zpbank-spec.md 2.2)

zp_pair.source: zpbank-review.md section 2, armed (the PS profile key, review finding 3)
